QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque()` (`constant_time_impl.h:85-93`) wraps values in `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))` so the compiler cannot prove a value and fold the mask back into a branch. It is a barrier against folding, not a timing guarantee.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows the empty `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))` with an in/out register operand and says it is only an optimisation barrier.
